I read §1t3489s0§ in full, :3083 to :3177: the setter's tail is :3160 'if(§1t1525s0§.§1t9948s0§())' -> :3162 'this.§1t4414s0§ -= 48;' -> :3163-3166 clamp at 0 -> :3169 repaint the bar. It costs 48. new_findings.text: THE FREE/CHARGED SPLIT IS REAL BUT THE GATE IS NOT SPLIT, AND EVERY WRITE-UP OF THIS CLUSTER SO FAR HAS BLURRED IT. The 48-Focus DEBIT is inside the battle predicate (§1t99s0§.as:3160-3162). The ENTRY GATE is not: §1t4470s0§ at :3048-3051 is 'return this.§1t4469s0§() && this.§1t4414s0§ >= 48;' and §1t4472s0§ opens at :3060 with 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ < 48) { return; }' — neither is wrapped in §1t9948s0§()/isBattle(). And the caller that reaches them outside a fight is the GLOBAL input handler, §1t1541s0§.as:605-615: 'case Keyboard.SPACE: _loc2_ = §1t1523s0§.§1t9586s0§(); if(!§1t10074s0§ && _loc2_.§1t4470s0§()) { _loc2_.§1t4472s0§(); ...Snd_smallClick } else { ...Snd_error }' — not a battle-only widget, unlike the BattleUI button at §1t113s0§.as:468-480. So the correct rule is THREE-part, not two: out of combat the switch costs nothing but still requires reload >= 48; in combat it requires reload >= 48 and spends 48. A recreation that ships 'free and unrestricted' overworld switching is wrong, and the error is invisible in play only because reload refills +1/tick (§1t99s0§.as:1203-1205) and the overworld HUD hides the bar entirely — which I confirmed on film at reference/frames/combat_frames/Nr4fQstqHDM_t0425s.png, crop (150,930)-(620,1080) 3x LANCZOS: two bars and the words 'HEAVY STANCE', no third bar.

new_findings.text: A BUILD LEAK INSIDE A SURVIVING FINDING, EXACTLY THE C2 TRAP. LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md:3644, [[ui-hud/in-combat-hud-is-three-bars]], says 'The third bar carries the status text CANNOT CHANGE STANCE when it is below a sixth of max.' A SIXTH is the ANDROID rule: MCSPlayer.as:2977 'if(this.reload < this.maxreload / 6) return;' over maxreload = 5 * 24 = 120 (:239), i.e. 20. The WEB build has no sixth anywhere in this path: §1t113s0§.as:328 draws the bar as '(param1 - 48) / (param2 - 48)' and shows the grey caption only at ratio == 0 (:336-343), over maxreload = 8 * 24 = 192 (§1t99s0§.as:249) — so the caption is on while reload <= 48, a QUARTER of max, and the threshold is the same flat 48 the stance gate uses (:3050, :3060). The finding names no build, which under §3(c) makes it the defective side rather than a genuine contradiction. Consequence if shipped as written: on a 192-tick meter the caption would clear at 32 instead of 48, and a stance switch would be offered for 16 ticks while the code still refuses it — the one visible state the whole cluster exists to reproduce.

new_findings.text: A STRUCTURAL FLAW IN HOW THIS LANE TESTS FRAME NOVELTY, FOUND BY BYTE-CHECK. reference/frames/combat_frames/Nr4fQstqHDM_t0435s.png and reference/frames/duel_frames/Nr4fQstqHDM_t435.0s.png are the SAME FILE under two names: md5 -q returns 5f55476bd80d4b448a26fae015b93b42 for both, and both are 858,599 bytes. The corpus already banks a reading of the second path at LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md:2029-2030 (HP 19/20, third bar 'roughly 40% filled WHITE with NO stance text'), and my own crop of the first path at (150,930)-(620,1080) 3x LANCZOS gives the identical picture (HP 19/20, Chi 26/26, ~42% white, no caption). A packet claim in this batch passes its own novelty test — "'combat_frames' appears exactly once in LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md", "'t0435' appears zero times" — while re-deriving a banked result, purely because the two directories name the same second differently ('t0435s' vs 't435.0s'). Two agreeing duplicates are harmless; the same aliasing would hide a real CONTRADICTION just as effectively, and the naming schemes differ by a zero-pad and a decimal point, so no string search catches it. Any future novelty check on frames must hash, not grep the path.

new_findings.text: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT INSTANCE OF THE S0-3 PARITY HOLE, IN THE SKILL TABLE RATHER THAN THE STRING TABLE. §1t120s0§.as:108, :110 and :112 declare '§1t10173s0§:int = 1074', '§1t10174s0§:int = 1075', '§1t10175s0§:int = 1076' — the three per-stance full-Focus evade passives the web hit-resolver tests at §1t99s0§.as:3383 and :3707. Those ids DO NOT EXIST in reference/extracted/skilldata.xml: its id sequence ends '... 1070 28 1071 30 1072 29 1073 31 1500 1501', i.e. it stops at 1073 and jumps to the two category-11 rows. Per correction C2 that XML came from the ANDROID build, so the three passives are a v0.717 addition with no v0.682 row to read — the same shape as the string-960 gap already banked at LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md:1883, but in a different table, which makes it a second independent proof rather than a restatement. Practical consequence: the chi cost, cooldown, level ladder and display name of the evade passives CANNOT be resolved from skilldata.xml or from resolved_names.json (both return null for 1074-1076); only the web ActionScript and the on-film skill card at reference/frames/zFtCaTO0_1M/seg-03/frames/frame_0013.jpg carry them.
